name: Tollex
description: Sells agents paid capabilities over x402: Robinhood Chain data, Stock Token quotes, x402 endpoint checks. Pay per call in USDC on Base or USDG; signed receipts.

skills.name: Free Capability Planning
skills.description: Resolves a plain-language need to a priced capability and input with POST /v1/resolve, without signing or spending anything.

skills.name: Pay Per Call
skills.description: Accepts x402 v2 exact payments in USDC on Base or USDG on Robinhood Chain for each call, settled on chain.

skills.name: Signed Execution Receipts
skills.description: Returns an EIP-712 receipt with every paid result, signed by a key published at /.well-known/tollex-receipt-keys.

skills.name: Robinhood Chain Data
skills.description: Reads blocks, logs, balances, Stock Token prices and halt status, and simulates calls on Robinhood Chain.

skills.name: x402 Endpoint Inspection
skills.description: Fetches any x402 URL unpaid and decodes its live v2 payment terms: network, asset, payTo and amount.
